reason: the sealed artifact and my report described the selection as "medoid, X-only". That overstates it. The 171-cluster universe is itself Y-SELECTED: those clusters exist only because their members survived the historical test. What is outcome-blind is the CHOICE OF REPRESENTATIVE within an already outcome-selected set.

what_is_still_true: Jaccard and sealed j carry no outcome information, so no representative was chosen for having the loudest result
